chapter: 1 provenance: host, job, private network namespace, checkouts, expected results
send: date -u; hostname; id -un; echo "Slurm job $SLURM_JOB_ID step $SLURM_STEP_ID"; ip -br addr   # unshare -rn: only lo, uid 0 is the user namespace's
for d in lcls2 wtA wtB wtF; do echo "$d $(git -C $d log -1 --format='%h %cI %s' | cut -c1-100) | dirty $(git -C $d status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l)"; done
git -C wtF diff   # the fix, in a scratch worktree of P, never committed

chapter: 2 the code: e2e.py:678-679, prometheus_targets since 71895fbda, scrape since 679ceb644
send: git -C lcls2 log -2 --format='%h %cI %s' -- psdaq/psdaq/webgui/e2e.py; git -C lcls2 blame -s -L 678,679 psdaq/psdaq/webgui/e2e.py

cd lcls2; grep -n 'prometheus_targets(\|^def scrape(' psdaq/psdaq/sim/daq_sim.py psdaq/psdaq/webgui/e2e.py; echo "P vs sim-main c0d9bb1, these 2 files: $(git diff 5eb773c84b9d c0d9bb1eae2c -- psdaq/psdaq/webgui/e2e.py psdaq/psdaq/sim/daq_sim.py | wc -l) diff lines"; cd ..

chapter: 3 the runner and the two read-back pollers
4 BEFORE: daq_sim e2e at P 5eb773c84b9d (--keep-up), read-back during the run
5 read-back after RESET (DAQ kept up), then daq_sim down
send: for p in 9200 9201; do echo "127.0.0.1:$p after RESET: http $(curl -s -m 2 -o $M/bef-reset-$p.txt -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:$p/metrics), $(grep -c '^TEB_' $M/bef-reset-$p.txt) TEB_ lines"; done
(cd lcls2 && source ./setup_env_daq.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 && daq_sim status -w $M/bef | tail -n 8 && daq_sim down -w $M/bef 2>&1 | tail -n 2)

chapter: 8 AFTER: e2e at P + the fix (wtF, uncommitted)

send: for r in bef a b fix; do echo "$r: $(grep -h -o 'in CONFIGURED: Prometheus {[^}]\{0,60\}' $M/$r.log) | $(grep -h -E '^E2E (PASS|FAIL)$' $M/$r.log) | shots: $(ls $M/$r/e2e-shots | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; date -u
